units.title: Recognizing spoken reductions

units.title: Emphasis and clefts

units.title: Reference and dislocation

units.title: Nominalization and agents

units.title: Negation and scope

units.title: Families and collocations

Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Literary past narration

Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Older subjunctive recognition

Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: The station transformation project

sentences.fr: C'est Léa qui a envoyé le rapport.
sentences.en: It is Léa who sent the report.
sentences.note: The highlighted noun is the subject of envoyer, so qui is required.

sentences.fr: C'est le rapport que Léa a envoyé.
sentences.en: It is the report that Léa sent.
sentences.note: The highlighted element is the direct object, so que is required.

sentences.fr: C'est moi qui ai proposé cette solution.
sentences.en: It is I who proposed this solution.
sentences.note: The relative verb agrees with first-person moi: ai.

sentences.fr: Ce qui m'inquiète, c'est le délai.
sentences.en: What worries me is the deadline.
sentences.note: Ce qui is the subject of inquiète.

sentences.fr: Ce dont nous avons besoin, c'est de temps.
sentences.en: What we need is time.
sentences.note: Avoir besoin de requires dont in this relative construction.

sentences.fr: Cette question, j'y ai déjà réfléchi.
sentences.en: I have already thought about this question.
sentences.note: Réfléchir à is represented by y.

sentences.fr: Cette proposition, nous l'avons étudiée.
sentences.en: We have studied this proposal.
sentences.note: The preceding direct object is feminine singular, hence étudiée.

sentences.fr: Je n'ai lu que l'introduction.
sentences.en: I have only read the introduction.
sentences.note: Ne...que restricts the object; it does not deny reading.

sentences.fr: Personne ne nous a rien dit.
sentences.en: Nobody told us anything.
sentences.note: Personne and rien combine in ordinary negative French.

sentences.fr: Une tout autre explication est possible.
sentences.en: An entirely different explanation is possible.
sentences.note: Tout modifies autre adverbially here.

sentences.fr: Toute autre réponse serait prématurée.
sentences.en: Any other answer would be premature.
sentences.note: Toute determines the feminine noun réponse.

sentences.fr: La réduction des tarifs a favorisé la participation.
sentences.en: The reduction in prices encouraged participation.
sentences.note: Nominalization packages an action as a noun phrase.

sentences.fr: Cette hypothèse reste néanmoins fragile.
sentences.en: This hypothesis nevertheless remains weak.
sentences.note: Néanmoins introduces a qualification or contrast.

sentences.fr: Elle aperçut la gare et ralentit.
sentences.en: She caught sight of the station and slowed down.
sentences.note: Passé simple advances a literary narrative.

sentences.fr: Quand elle eut terminé, elle sortit.
sentences.en: When she had finished, she went out.
sentences.note: Passé antérieur expresses completion before a passé simple event.

sentences.fr: La rue était vide lorsqu'il arriva.
sentences.en: The street was empty when he arrived.
sentences.note: Imparfait sets the scene; passé simple introduces the event.

sentences.fr: Bien qu'il fût tard, ils poursuivirent la discussion.
sentences.en: Although it was late, they continued the discussion.
sentences.note: Fût is a literary imperfect subjunctive after bien que.

sentences.fr: Elle souhaitait qu'il vînt.
sentences.en: She wanted him to come.
sentences.note: Vînt is the literary imperfect subjunctive of venir.

sentences.fr: Le projet pourrait éventuellement être reporté.
sentences.en: The project could possibly be postponed.
sentences.note: Éventuellement means possibly, not eventually.

sentences.fr: Encore faudrait-il que nous disposions du temps nécessaire.
sentences.en: We would still need to have enough time.
sentences.note: This formal reservation uses conditional falloir and subjunctive disposer.

grammar.explanation: Léa is the subject of appeler, so qui is required.
Je is the subject; Léa is the direct object, represented by que.

grammar.prompt: C'est moi qui ___ envoyé le dossier.
grammar.explanation: The relative verb agrees with moi, first person singular.

grammar.prompt: Le sujet ___ je parle est le budget.

grammar.explanation: Réfléchir à une question is represented by y.

grammar.prompt: Les lettres qu'elle a ___ sont anciennes.
grammar.explanation: Que represents preceding direct object les lettres, feminine plural.

grammar.prompt: I read only the introduction: Je n'ai lu ___ l'introduction.

grammar.explanation: Personne as subject combines with ne.

grammar.prompt: An entirely different solution: une ___ autre solution.
grammar.explanation: Tout is an adverb modifying autre here.

grammar.prompt: Quand elle ___ terminé, elle sortit. (literary prior completion)
grammar.explanation: Eut terminé is passé antérieur before passé simple sortit.

grammar.prompt: Bien qu'il ___ tard, ils poursuivirent leur route. (literary subjunctive)
grammar.explanation: Fût, with circumflex, is literary imperfect subjunctive after bien que.
The ordinary meaning is possibly or if appropriate.

grammar.prompt: Which collocation means to conduct a survey?
grammar.explanation: Mener une enquête is the standard collocation here.

grammar.prompt: Encore faudrait-il que chacun ___ du temps.
grammar.explanation: Falloir que governs the subjunctive; dispose is third-person present subjunctive.
